Hi Samantha —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed activation plan so we can align owners and timeline. Please review and confirm the infra/security/procurement owners on your side.

High-level goal: 2-week technical trial to validate latency, cost, and integration with your data plane; decision point is a go/no-go to progress to a 90-day pilot.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 350ms for 512-token prompts under average load.
- Cost: token unit cost <= $0.015 per 1k tokens for the trial config.
- Functional: API + streaming + tool-calling integration completed; embedding similarity matches baseline (internal test set A, >0.88 recall).
- Security/compliance: either hosted SOC 2 evidence or Private deployment with customer-managed KMS; audit logging accessible to AvaTech.

POC evaluation plan (technical owner / expected deliverable):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm owners & sign NDA/procurement pre-reqs (Vanessa)
- Week 1: Provisioning & smoke tests (Rishi)
- Week 2: Load tests + success criteria validation (AvaTech infra + Redwood)
- Week 3: Results review and next-step decision (stakeholders)

Ask: please confirm the following on your side by EOD Friday (17 Jul):
1) AvaTech infra owner for networking/VPC/k8s (name + email)
2) Security owner for SOC/KMS approvals
3) Procurement contact for T&Cs & PO timelines

Internal owners (Redwood):
- Sales / engagement: Priyom Das (me) — trial lead, PO/engagement owner
- Security validation: Olga Petrov — SOC/KMS integration checklist
- Procurement & contracting: Vanessa Ortiz — commercial terms & procurement path
- Dedicated infra setup: Rishi Malhotra — capacity plan and provisioning

Attached: Redwood_POCChecklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with detailed tasks).

Proposed kickoff: Thu 22 Jul 10am PT for a 30-minute handoff (we can shift if that doesn't work).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,

Priyom —

Quick answers from Security:
- SOC 2: Redwood hosted environments are covered by SOC 2 Type II; I will pull the compliance pack and share a redacted version for AvaTech.
- KMS: For Hosted we support Redwood-managed keys by default; customer-managed KMS (Bring Your Own Key) is available but requires Private deployment or a dedicated HSM configuration — not typically available for a 2-week hosted trial.
- Lead time: Private deployment with customer-managed KMS typically needs ~3-4 weeks for provisioning + key exchange, depending on region.

I'll own security validation and will share the SOC pack + a short checklist for the AvaTech security review by Mon 20 Jul.
